title: Nourishing Norwegian Beef Stew
description: A hearty, comforting stew made with tender beef, rich confit tomatoes, and earthy root vegetables, perfect for a chilly Norwegian evening.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium heat and add a couple of tablespoons of oil.
Brown the short ribs on all sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Remove the ribs from the pot and set them aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the carrots and celery and sauté until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the confit tomatoes, beef broth, red wine (if using), bay leaves, and thyme.
Return the short ribs to the pot and bring the stew to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the stew for about 2 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the vegetables are very soft.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
